void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Page background, hero backdrop, product mockup canvas

obsidian-surface.$description: Obsidian Surface — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

carbon-layer.$description: Carbon Layer — Secondary surface level, nested panels, code editor background

graphite-panel.$description: Graphite Panel — Product UI inner panels, inbox sidebar, tabbed editor frames

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline 1px borders on cards, inputs, dividers — the only visible separation in a no-shadow system

steel-text.$description: Steel Text — Muted body text, secondary labels, nav items, partner logo washes

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Helper text, icon strokes, tertiary metadata

smoke-divider.$description: Smoke Divider — Deeper dividers, inactive tab underlines, icon outlines at rest

bone-text.$description: Bone Text — Primary body text at 400 weight, the high-contrast default on void canvas

pure-light.$description: Pure Light — Headlines at full weight, button text on dark fills, emphasis runs

plasma-violet.$description: Plasma Violet — Primary brand accent — underlines, brand glow, active states, the signature chromatic note

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Secondary brand violet, code syntax keywords, badge fills, gradient partner with Plasma Violet

wisteria.$description: Wisteria — Deeper violet for hover states, brand gradients, emphasis borders

ember-pink.$description: Ember Pink — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis; The signature magenta smoke texture erupting behind the hero product mockup — radial wash from #f76e99 through pinks to deep crimson

circuit-teal.$description: Circuit Teal — Code syntax strings, live cursors in multiplayer UI, data-viz highlights

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Softer teal for secondary presence states, comment thread highlights

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Code syntax types, link accents, comment thread timestamp markers

sky-pulse.$description: Sky Pulse — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cloud-mist.$description: Cloud Mist — Near-white blue tint used in shadow glows behind key elements

suisse-intl.$description: The sole interface typeface. All UI text, headings, nav, buttons, labels. 64px headlines use -0.02em tracking to tighten the Swiss grotesque rhythm; micro-text (10-12px) uses positive 0.01-0.025em tracking for legibility. The 1.0 line-height on display sizes is a signature choice — text feels compressed against the void.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Code blocks only. 14px body, 10px annotations. 0.025em positive tracking gives monospace text air without feeling scattered.
